content.title: Fans fear for the future of The Bachelorette as sponsors cut ties after Taylor Frankie Paul’s ex calls cops
content.text: TAYLOR Frankie Paul’s season of The Bachelorette faces being pulled off air amid her domestic violence investigation, fans say. Sponsors are cutting ties with the show amid a domestic violence investigation involving Taylor, 31, and her ex Dakota Mortensen. Sign up for the Entertainment newsletter Thank you! Taylor Frankie Paul is season 22’s BacheloretteCredit: Disney Taylor is due to catapult onto screens as The Bachelorette on March 22Credit: Disney She is currently embroiled in a domestic violence investigationCredit: Disney Dakota reportedly called police during an altercation at The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives star Taylor‘s Utah house a few weeks ago – just as she was preparing for her on-screen debut as ABC’s The Bachelorette. The show is due to premiere on ABC and Hulu on March 22, but because of the investigation, fans fear the episode may be pushed back or pulled altogether. After the news of Cinnabon ending its partnership with The Bachelorette and The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives following the allegations, fans have grown concerned for the shows’ futures. According to Variety, “the investigation will not impact the release schedule or press plans for The Bachelorette.” A source then told Rob Shuter in a story published on his Naughty But Nice Substack, “This has turned into a full-blown crisis. “There are serious conversations happening about whether the show can move forward as planned. “When sponsors start running, networks panic, and that’s exactly what’s happening here.“ Fans also think that sponsors pulling out means there is trouble on the horizon. Most read in TV On Reddit, one person said, “I hope advertisers start pulling because honestly that’s the ONLY way abc will cancel the season.” “ABC needs to pull the show,” added another. “If I could make a bet, I would wager by Sunday the show will not be airing. At best ‘delayed’, more likely canceled,” said a third. A fourth then penned, “ This is so embarrassing. The show is done for. These producers have terrible discernment.” While a fifth said, “I think they should pull it just based off things i saw in season 4 of mormon wives.” But a sixth was hopeful and added, “There is no way. People are going to flock to watch.” And someone else echoed, “They won’t be pulling it, but I bet they are currently re-editing it right now lol.” When Cinnabon pulled out of advertising on Bachelorette and SLOMW, a spokesperson said: “Cinnabon has made the decision to terminate its collaboration with ‘The Bachelorette’ and ‘The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives’. “Recent developments and allegations surrounding the lead cast member led us to reassess this collaboration as it no longer aligns with our brand values,” they told Entertainment Weekly. Meanwhile, filming for season five of Mormon Wives has been paused. Variety reports that the show “has been paused due to the investigation”. They say it will likely be relatively brief, with production “expected to resume soon with little impact on the Season 5 release timeline”. Sources exclusively told The U.S. Sun that while production pushed to continue filming, Taylor’s co-stars refused to go on before the situation was properly addressed.
